question: To Oda-sensei. Aren't you going to draw Robin's flashback? Robin: "Cinco Fleur!!" by Nami-n
answer: Look out! I barely dodged Robin's attack. Her flashback? Sounds like a lot of readers are curious. I'm drawing it now! Yes, right now!! Which means it should be in the next volume. I'll do my best.
name: Nami-n
